The '''C-M Frag Storm heavy shotgun''' was a prototype kinetic shotgun produced by the [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who assisted either the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] or the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] during the [[Battle of Restuss]] and received [[commendation]]s for their actions were able to requisition this rifle from a factionally aligned [[Commendation officer]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This rifle is one of the many items featured in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' as part of the [[Battle of Restuss]] story arc. Players may receive commendation items for assisting their chosen faction, which could be stacked and traded for various items from Commendation Officer [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Characters]] (NPCs).
